_note: Words for Snooze and "Remind me if no reply". Edit the wording here. {when}, {count} and {days} are filled in by the app.
snoozeIntro: It leaves your inbox now and comes back to the top when it's due.
pickBad: Choose a time from a minute from now to a year ahead.
snoozedNote: Snoozed until {when}. It will come back to the top of your inbox then, or sooner if someone replies.
emptyText: Snooze an email to hide it until you're ready for it. It comes back to the top of your inbox at the time you choose.
remindSet: We'll remind you {when} if nobody replies
remindPending: If nobody replies, this comes back to your inbox {when}.
noReplyNote: Nobody has replied to this yet. Follow it up, or press Done if you don't need to.
failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
